about: Spie is a multitechnical services group for energy and communications, whose main business is based in France, though the input shows a Bern, Switzerland location, probably a Swiss business unit. SPIE designs, installs and maintains electrical, mechanical and HVAC systems, and data centre and telecom networks, for buildings and industry, with revenue of about 9 billion euros and listed on Euronext Paris. B2B with low consumer awareness.

about: Urbaser is a Madrid based environmental services company, one of Spain's leading waste management firms, offering municipal waste collection, street cleaning, treatment and recycling, plus water services in Spain, Latin America and Europe. Customers are cities and public authorities under long-term contracts. It operates in many countries, with revenue of around 3 billion euros. Municipal B2B contractor with low consumer brand awareness.

about: Enviromena is a UK based developer of photovoltaic solar projects, operating in the Middle East and North Africa and elsewhere, with a Reading office per the input. It developed utility and commercial scale solar plants for customers in the region. Scale, ownership and current status are not confirmed. B2B with no consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: PolarDC Group is a London-based operator of high-performance computing (HPC) data centre facilities, with a sustainability focus, according to the input. It serves customers needing capacity for artificial intelligence and computing. Its sites, capacity, funding and ownership are not described. B2B infrastructure. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: PolarDC Group is an operator of HPC data center facilities.

about: Chart Industries is a US industrial gas equipment maker, with a Crunchbase location of Ball Ground, Georgia (Atlanta area), designing and manufacturing process equipment for cryogenic gas handling, such as storage tanks, heat exchangers, LNG liquefaction equipment, hydrogen and carbon capture systems. Customers are energy, industrial gas and chemical firms. It was listed on the NYSE (GTLS), and in 2025 Baker Hughes agreed to acquire it for about $13.6 billion. B2B industrial brand, with no consumer awareness.

Premier Energy is a Romanian and Moldovan energy company, based in Bucharest, that supplies and distributes electricity and gas, operates renewable assets and offers energy solutions to households and businesses. It is the main electricity distributor in Moldova and has grown through acquisitions, backed by private investors. Funding of about EUR 916M was recorded in 2026, partly debt. Utility brand known to customers in Moldova and Romania, with limited recognition elsewhere.

about: Resideo Technologies is a Scottsdale, Arizona maker of home comfort and security products such as Honeywell Home thermostats, First Alert smoke detectors, and distributor ADI Global Distribution. It was spun off from Honeywell in 2018 and is listed on NYSE (REZI). Customers are installers, retailers and homeowners. The Honeywell Home brand is well known in the US. Revenue comes from product sales and distribution, with about 6 billion dollars in annual sales. The Honeywell Home brand is licensed from Honeywell and widely recognised by US homeowners.

Teamworks is a Durham, North Carolina software company that provides an operating system for sports organisations, including scheduling, communication, compliance, recruiting, NIL and athlete performance tools, used by college athletic departments, pro teams and leagues. Founded in 2008, it acquired Smartabase, Dabo, and others, and has raised about $422 million. Customers are teams, colleges and leagues. B2B sports technology with strong recognition inside the sports industry.

Pebl is a US company in Palo Alto, California, described by Crunchbase as offering a global employment solution, covering hiring and employing workers across countries. It reports roughly 500 million dollars of funding, though I cannot reliably identify this specific company or its ownership. Likely a B2B HR technology and employment services business with low consumer awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Warner Bros. Discovery is a US media and entertainment group headquartered in New York, formed in 2022 by the merger of WarnerMedia and Discovery. It owns Warner Bros. studios, HBO and Max streaming, CNN, TNT Sports, Discovery Channel, Eurosport and many other networks, earning from subscriptions, advertising and content licensing. Listed on Nasdaq (WBD) with revenue of about $40 billion and plans to split into two companies. It holds major sports rights, so it is relevant to advertising and F1-style broadcast partnerships.

wiki.title: Warner Bros. Discovery
wiki.what: Former American mass media and entertainment conglomerate
wiki.text: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It was formed on April 8, 2022, by the merger of Discovery, Inc. with AT&T subsidiary WarnerMedia, with the latter being the successor of Kinney National Company and Time Inc. Warner Bros. Discovery operated via two divisions: Streaming & Studios and Global Linear Networks. Streaming & Studios included the flagship Warner Bros. studios, HBO, DC Entertainment, and streaming services such as HBO Max and Discovery+. about: Canada's largest travel loyalty programme, owned by Air Canada and based in Montreal, with millions of members who earn and redeem points on flights, hotels, car rentals and partner spending. Revenue comes from airlines and commercial partners. Consumer loyalty brand with high awareness across Canada.

Data-driven marketing technology firm headquartered in New York, selling a cloud platform that uses AI and consumer data to run email, mobile and ad campaigns for brands. Listed on NYSE (ZETA), founded by David Steinberg. Customers include large retailers and financial firms. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Razor Group is a Berlin-based e-commerce aggregator that acquires and scales third-party sellers on Amazon and other marketplaces, building a portfolio of consumer brands across categories like home, kitchen and pet. It raised large equity and debt financing in 2021-2022 (about $1.1 billion in total). Customers are consumers via Amazon. Brand is largely B2B and investor-facing; its products are sold under many small brands.

about: Baidu is a Beijing-based Chinese internet and AI company operating China's largest search engine, along with the Ernie AI models, Apollo Go robotaxi service, iQIYI streaming and cloud services. Founded 2000 by Robin Li. Revenue is about 130 billion yuan, largely advertising plus AI cloud. Listed on Nasdaq (BIDU) and Hong Kong (9888). Huge consumer brand in China.

wiki.title: Baidu
wiki.text: Baidu, Inc. ( BY-doo; Chinese: 百度; pinyin: Bǎidù; lit. 'hundred times') is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in internet services and artificial intelligence. It holds a leading share of China's search engine market via Baidu Search and provides other internet services, including Baidu App (its flagship app for search and newsfeed), Baidu Baike (a user-edited, Wikipedia-like encyclopedia), iQIYI (a video streaming service), Baidu Tieba (a forum platform similar to Reddit), and ES File Explorer. about: Multi-Color Corporation is a global manufacturer of label solutions for consumer brands in home and personal care, food and beverage, wine and spirits, healthcare and specialty sectors, making pressure-sensitive, in-mould, shrink sleeve and cut-and-stack labels. It operates dozens of plants across North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia and Australia. Based in Atlanta, Georgia, it was taken private by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice in 2019 after being listed on Nasdaq (LABL). B2B packaging supplier whose labels appear on well-known products but whose name has no consumer visibility.

Whop is an online marketplace and platform, founded in 2021, where creators and businesses sell digital products, software, courses, paid communities and memberships, with built-in payments, access control and affiliate tools. It serves creators, traders, online entrepreneurs and small digital businesses, and earns a percentage of transactions. The Crunchbase figure of about $478 million in funding looks high for its venture funding, and may include other measures, and no HQ is shown in the data. Popular among online creators, with limited general consumer awareness.

Pattern is a Lehi, Utah-based e-commerce acceleration company that helps consumer brands such as Nike, Lego and Bose sell on Amazon and marketplaces worldwide, offering advertising, logistics and software. Listed on Nasdaq in 2025 (PTRN). Founded in 2013, it employs around 1,500 people, and has revenue of roughly $2 billion. B2B and little brand awareness among consumers.

DNEG is a London based visual effects and animation studio, formerly Double Negative, which has won multiple Oscars for visual effects on films such as Inception, Interstellar, Blade Runner 2049, Tenet and Dune. It works for studios like Warner Bros, Netflix and Disney in London, Los Angeles, Vancouver, Mumbai and elsewhere, with thousands of artists. Owned by Prime Focus and investors including Novator and Brookfield. Known in film circles and used in F1 media productions.

VidMob is a creative performance platform for advertisers, offering AI-powered tools that analyse ad creative, connect it to campaign results and produce video, social and display ads at scale through a network of creators. Customers are major brands and agencies, and it earns software and services fees. Founded in 2013 and based in New York, it raised about $240 million from investors including Ridge Ventures and Blue Cloud. B2B ad-tech brand with limited consumer awareness.

iHeartMedia is the largest US radio broadcaster, with roughly 850 stations, listed on Nasdaq (IHRT) and run from a base in San Antonio with a New York presence. It owns the iHeartRadio streaming app, a large podcast network, Premiere Networks syndication, and live events including the iHeartRadio Music Festival and Jingle Ball, and sells advertising to national and local brands. It reaches over 90% of Americans monthly, with revenue of about $3.8 billion. Strong consumer media brand.

Cloud broadcast technology company founded in India, providing software to create, distribute and monetise video channels, including FAST channels, for broadcasters, streaming services and content owners. Customers include major US and international media groups, and it earns recurring software and service fees. Operations are split between Bengaluru and the US, with a New York base on its record, and it has worked toward a public listing. B2B brand known inside the media industry.

about: Streaming platform company based in San Jose, California, listed on Nasdaq (ROKU), whose operating system powers Roku TVs and streaming players, with roughly 90 million streaming households. It earns most revenue from advertising on The Roku Channel and its home screen, plus platform fees and device sales. Founded in 2002 by Anthony Wood. Strong US consumer brand, a major advertising channel, and an established connected-TV partner for sports content.

wiki.title: Roku
wiki.text: Roku ( ROH-koo) is a brand of consumer electronics that includes digital media players, smart TVs (and their operating systems), as well as two streaming services (The Roku Channel and Howdy). The brand is owned by Roku, Inc., which is owned by Fox Corporation. As of 2024, Roku was the U.S. market leader in streaming video distribution, reaching nearly 145 million people.

about: Kape Technologies is a London-based digital privacy company, formerly listed on the London Stock Exchange AIM, which owns the VPN brands ExpressVPN, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access and Zenmate, plus Intego antivirus software. Customers are consumers who buy monthly or annual subscriptions, totalling millions of subscribers, with annual revenue of about 300 million dollars. It was acquired in 2023 by Unikmind Holdings, a company of the Israeli billionaire Teddy Sagi, and delisted. Strong consumer brands through ExpressVPN and CyberGhost, which have sponsored sports teams and online media.

KTM is an Austrian motorcycle maker known for off-road, adventure and street bikes, and for its racing record in MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, Dakar and motocross. It belongs to the former Pierer Mobility group, with Bajaj Auto of India holding the controlling stake after the 2024-25 restructuring. The data lists a Singapore address and funding of about 1.2B, which probably refers to a financing arrangement. Strong global motorsport brand with major sponsorship presence, and sells through dealers worldwide.

wiki.title: KTM
wiki.what: Austrian motorcycle and sports car manufacturer
wiki.text: KTM AG (German pronunciation: [ˌkɑːˌteːˈɛm]) is an Austrian motorcycle, bicycle and motorsports brand. It traces its foundation to 1934, as Kronreif & Trunkenpolz Mattighofen. Today, Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly Pierer Mobility AG) operates as the manufacturer of KTM-branded motorcycles, and KTM Fahrrad GmbH operates as the manufacturer of KTM-branded bicycles. KTM is known for its off-road motorcycles and as a reputed MotoGP constructor. In November 2025, it was announced that Bajaj Auto had completed the acquisition of a controlling stake in KTM for €800 million, increasing its indirect holding to approximately 75%.

about: Global private members' club and hospitality group with roughly 40 Soho Houses, beach clubs and co-working spaces in cities such as London, New York, Los Angeles and Miami, plus Soho Works, Soho Home furniture and Cecconi's restaurants. Members pay annual fees and spend on food, drink and stays; membership runs to hundreds of thousands. Founded by Nick Jones in 1995 in London, it listed on the NYSE (SHCO) in 2021 and agreed a 2025 take-private by MCR. Premium lifestyle brand with strong affluent-consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Soho House
wiki.what: House and museum in Birmingham, England
wiki.text: Soho House is a museum run by Birmingham Museums Trust, celebrating Matthew Boulton's life, his partnership with James Watt, his membership of the Lunar Society of Birmingham and his contribution to the Midlands Enlightenment and the Industrial Revolution. It is a Grade II* listed 18th-century house in Handsworth, part of Birmingham since 1911, but historically in the county of Staffordshire. It was the home of entrepreneur Matthew Boulton from 1766 until his death in 1809, and a regular meeting-place of the Lunar Society.

about: Gren is a Helsinki-based energy company, known as a producer of heat and power with district heating, electricity and gas operations tied to Nordic and Baltic cities. Crunchbase describes it simply as an energy utility services provider and the data provided gives no further detail. Funding of about 1.15 billion (currency as shown) is dated May 2026. Customers would be municipalities, households and industrial users, paying heating and energy fees, and the business would not carry a strong consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
